name: Layout Builder Instant Preview
description: Live in-place previews of custom blocks and layout sections while editing them in Layout Builder.
project_description: The Layout Builder Instant Preview module provides live previews when editing custom blocks in Layout Builder. Rather than filling out a block form, saving, and then looking at the result, the block's rendered output updates in place as the form is changed. It is a fork of Panopoly Magic, differing in that it renders in the default off-canvas sidebar instead of a modal dialog, previews only custom (non block_content) blocks rather than all fields or system blocks, also previews layout-section configuration, and adds support for Drupal 10/11 and CKEditor 5. It works by swapping three core Layout Builder routes (add-block, update-block, configure-section) for enhanced versions that add Preview/Cancel buttons and an 'Automatic preview' toggle, plus a JavaScript behavior that re-submits the form on change.
